visualCharacteristics: Full-width cover hero split into a greeting panel over a background image and a looping 4:3 video with custom player controls (play/pause, skip, time, speed, volume, fullscreen).
contentPattern: Rows classified by content: an image row (greeting background), a row with the h1 headline and lede paragraph, and a paragraph linking to the video (an mp4 file or an AEM Assets video link such as its /play URL).
usage: Opening block of IF-Hub hub pages; also hosts the hub page section reveal.
reuseGuidance: Use once at the top of each hub page. For a plain image hero without video use the standard hero block.
